opportunity.name: GST Invoice Generator for Indian Freelancers
opportunity.target_customer: Indian freelancers and sole proprietors issuing GST invoices
opportunity.problem: Freelancers assemble GST invoices manually in spreadsheets, making format and field errors.
opportunity.proposed_solution: A focused generator producing compliant invoice PDFs with the required GST fields.

facts_from_evidence.claim: A GST invoice must show the supplier GSTIN, invoice number and date, HSN/SAC code, and place of supply.
Freelancers in the owner's network assemble invoices manually in spreadsheets and report field errors as a recurring annoyance.

market_research.customer_segment: Indian freelancers and sole proprietors issuing GST invoices

price_assumption.basis: USD 2/month entry subscription — stated assumption for Indian freelancer pricing

break_even.note: Break-even = ceil(recurring monthly costs / contribution per sale).

budget.note: Compatible means startup + first month recurring fits the owner's stated budget. The budget figure is the owner's; the engine never raises it (§13.6).
